key.description: current: the run asked for; prior_period: the run of the same length just before; prior_year: the same months a year earlier; ytd: the financial year's first month to the run's last. A balance sheet account's figure is its position at the column's last day, a P&L account's the movement over the column's months.

label.description: The column's heading; left out, the builder names it.
